subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The central skateboarder remains visually consistent across shots: black shirt, dark pants, dark helmet/cap, purple shoes, and skateboard. Shot 0 is heavily cropped, so identity evidence there is weaker, but it does not contradict the later shots.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots stay in the same outdoor skate bowl with tan curved walls, blue coping/rails, chain-link fencing, trees, and bright sunlight.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low near-concrete view and left-to-right motion are plausible, but the skateboarder is partly cropped at frame edge.
Side tracking view of the rider carving in the bowl fits well; an extra partial figure appears at the far left but is not central.
The ollie/action is visible, but the requested overhead angle is not really present; it reads more like a close low/side view.
Behind-rider follow view with a lean into motion is consistent with the caption.
Telephoto-like cross-bowl view and speed are plausible, though background streaking is modest.
Front three-quarter rollout is mostly present, but the rider is cropped at the top and the pose is mid-trick rather than clearly settled.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves distinct framings and action states: cropped low entry, side carve, close jump, rear follow, across-bowl view, and front three-quarter rollout.

motion_continuity.rationale: The frames show clear progression through rolling, carving, popping the board, landing, accelerating, and stabilizing. There is no freeze or copy-frame behavior.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks cross-shot consistency; the largest weakness is shot 2's camera angle not matching the overhead caption rather than an identity or scene break.

cheat_flags.rationale: Shots are visually varied and show changing body poses, board orientation, scale, and camera placement.
